Tuition & Fees
Tuition rates are established by the UW Regents at the end of spring quarter. You can find complete tuition and fee information at the website of the Office of Planning and Budgeting.
Tuition & Fees
There are three quarters in the standard academic year (autumn, winter, spring); summer quarter is optional. To review the tuition rates for our graduate programs, please use the Graduate Tuition Dashboard.
A prospective international student must have financial evidence showing that they or a sponsor has sufficient funds to cover tuition and living expenses during the period of intended study. An estimate of annual expenses for UW international students and their dependents can be found on the International Student Services website for planning.
The Graduate School provides a variety of resources to help students identify funding opportunities, See How do I pay for graduate school?
Funding
Master of Science
The majority of our master’s students are self-funded. However, MSECE students may apply for the few Teaching Assistant and Research Assistant positions available on a quarterly basis in ECE or other departments.
Ph.D.
Admitted Ph.D. students may receive funding through research and teaching assistantships, fellowships and departmental support provided they are making satisfactory progress toward their degree.
Fellowships
UW ECE Graduate Scholarships
Irene C. Peden Fellowship for female Ph.D. students in UW ECE. This is an annual Ph.D. fellowship, and Graduate Advising will reach out to all PhD students with additional details once the nomination form goes live each year.
